meta.title: AI instructions: when to use ecentic
meta.description: How people and agents can use ecentic, where its capabilities stop, and where to find the public API, MCP and current documentation.

instructions.title: Give an agent a clear starting point.
instructions.description: ecentic is one layer between a brand's catalog and the AI assistants that sell it. It optimizes the data they read, gets checkout ready for them to buy, and changes with them when their rules change.

items.title: Connect and compare
items.body: Import a Shopify, WooCommerce or supported feed catalog. Run on-demand comparisons with ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini and inspect the products and attributes behind each result.
items.label: Explore simulations

items.title: Fix with your approval
items.body: Apply generates and publishes a title and description using existing product facts. Structured data and Merchant Center sync have separate controls. Connecting Shopify also installs visit tracking. Publishing requires a supported direct connector.
items.label: Explore listing fixes

items.title: Enable supported agent checkout
items.body: Use the implemented checkout surface with your supported integration. Availability and merchant controls are described on the channel and integration pages.
items.label: Explore agent checkout

items.title: Inspect AI visits
items.body: See classified visits and destinations. A browser script cannot observe every crawler, and an AI referral does not establish an individual shopper-to-order link.
items.label: Explore tracking

sections.title: Keep the evidence in its context.
paragraphs: Simulations describe a test, not a live marketplace ranking or a guaranteed sale. The free store check uses three assistants; the separate free product comparison tool can use four.

ecentic does not run ad campaigns, host a storefront, manage inventory or fulfill orders. A published ChatGPT app listing has not been confirmed, so that app remains Coming soon. ACP remains Coming soon.
